This mod adds cross-platform events for adding Sodium/Embeddium options menu integration. For example, you can add an option page to Embeddium on Forge, Fabric Sodium 0.5 on 1.20.1, and Fabric/NeoForge Sodium 0.6 on 1.21.1 with one event:

 
OptionGUIConstruction.EVENT.register((pages) - pages.add(new TestOptionPage()));
 

If you're an end user, and you don't have this mod installed already as a library for another Sodium addon, you can install it alongside Reese's Options to get improved category menu, with drop-down support so that it's easier to navigate. night-config-fixes:
Night Config Fixes exists for the sole purpose of implementing a workaround for the rather common com.electronwill.nightconfig.core.io.ParsingException: Not enough data available issue related to config loading when using the Night Config library (used by Forge's config system, as well as many mods on Fabric). 
 There have been daily reports mentioning this issue for the Better Minecraft mod packs, which feels common enough to provide a dedicated workaround mod. 
 
 
 ▶️ The issue occurs randomly where a config file will just go blank and Night Config will throw the exception when trying to read that file next time. 
 ▶️ Night Config Fixes makes sure this no longer crashes the game, but instead catches the exception and simply recreates the config from its default values. 
 ▶️ Modpacks must put their configured config files in the defaultconfigs d

 Screenshot controls

Press F9 to take a screenshot.

The game is temporarily rendered at the configured resolution, the screenshot is captured, and the original resolution is restored automatically.

By default, screenshots are captured at 3840 × 2160 (4k).

- Custom screenshot width and height

SMWYG Fix
A lightweight, client-side drop-in fix for the Show Me What You Got (SMWYG) mod.

 The Problem
The original SMWYG mod can occasionally cause client crashes or server kicks under specific conditions:
- Illegal Characters Kick: When sharing items with certain formatting codes inherited from server-side plugins or other mods, the game may kick you for "Illegal characters in chat".

 Features
This mod applies surgical fixes via Mixins to solve these issues without altering original functionality:
- Automatic Sanitization: Strips illegal section signs (§) from item display names before they are sent to the chat field, preventing kicks.
- Bounds Memory: Implements index-aware sanitization to ensure SMWYG's internal character tracking remains accurate.

 Installation
1. Ensure you have the Fabric Loader installed for 1.20.1.
2. Download the smwyg-fix JAR.
3. Place it in your .minecraf

feature-nbt-deadlock-be-gone:
This mod's sole goal is to fix this bug that only exists for 1.18 MC: https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-246262

-----

The bug is when placing NBT builds into the world during worldgen, it can deadlock the game if the build is replacing a BlockEntity of any kind. Spawners, chests, lecterns, beds, signs, etc. Which is... bad. Your game locks up and freezes. Ticks are no longer being run. 

 

The issue comes down to the fact that the method used to place build's blocks in the world is not worldgen safe. It is using the wrong world object inside. The way this mod fixes the bug is by simply skipping the calls to those unsafe methods if the world passed into the nbt placing method is a WorldGenRegion class. More info and in-depth detail is in the bug report above. 

 

For mods, this bug may occur more often which is why it may be a good idea to just have this mod on as a precaution.

buttonfix:
A small client-side mod that fixes widget focus issues in any in-game GUI.

 

In Vanilla, GUI buttons and sliders remain focused after a mouse click until another widget claims focus for every version since 1.19.4. This can be visually distracting - especially when using resource packs that change the appearance of GUI widgets.
Button Fix resolves this issue by properly resetting the focus after interaction.
 
 

 

This fix applies to all sliders and pressable widgets in in-game GUIs - for example, the recipe book button in the inventory screen, or the buttons and sliders in the main menu, pause menu, or mod config screens - as long as they use vanilla widget implementations.

libnine is a library that provides a bunch of boilerplate code for content mods to use. It mostly consists of various bits of code that I found useful in more than one project, which I then factored out into a shared library. Particularly notable features include:

 Automatic generation of NBT and byte stream serializers based on annotated fields
 Various prefab capability implementations
 A generic recipe registry system
 "Parametric item models" that can depend on nontrivial item stack state
 A GUI component system and corresponding sync code
 A huge pile of linear algebra nonsense

However, a lot of the code in this project is rather dated and the architecture is a little bit questionable. As such, I would not recommend depending on libnine for new modding projects.

mobstacker:
MobStacker is a performance Minecraft mod to optimize entity handling, addressing a common cause of performance issues in vanilla and modded environments. By intelligently "stacking" similar mobs in close proximity, MobStacker significantly reduces server load and enhances client-side performance without compromising gameplay mechanics.

 Requires : Dungeon Config and Fabric API. MobStacker is server side only : players don't need it installed to join.

 Note : MobStacker preserves all loot and mob properties within stacked entities. Named mobs (via name tags) are exempt from stacking to maintain uniqueness.

 Key Benefits

1. Server Performance Boost : Dramatically reduces entity processing overhead.
2. Enhanced Client FPS : Lowers strain on client-side rendering.
3. Optimized Network Traffic : Minimizes entity data transmission.
4. Cleaner Gameplay : Reduces visual clutter in mob-dense

tpsum:
Tpsum is a small, performance-focused optimization mod for Minecraft (Forge/NeoForge). 
It targets hot paths that are executed extremely often during normal gameplay (server tick, mob spawning, biome lookup, and worldgen), aiming to reduce CPU time and avoidable allocations/GC pressure.

⚠️ No new content - Tpsum only improves performance.

 Highlights

 Mob spawning (NaturalSpawner) optimizations 
 faster spawn checks and fewer expensive calls in the spawn hot path
 Faster biome lookup 
 cached noise-biome source and small math hot-path improvements
 Reduced worldgen allocations 
 pooled feature placement context to lower GC load
 Task loop improvements 
 optimized BlockableEventLoop queueing/counting for high task throughput

 More details / technical breakdown

All optimizations, behavior notes, and profiling details are documented in the GitHub repository:

 https://github.com/DeusSi

This mod adds two blocks.

The first block emits a redstone signal while players are near; the other block emits a redstone signal while mobs are near.

The detection range of either block can be set to a 2-, 4-, 8-, or 16- block spherical radius; this range can by cycled by activating the blocks.

The mob detector can also be set to only detect one type of entity. This can be done by using a slimeball on an entity (either shift-right-clicking the mob or attacking it with the slimeball) to obtain an Imprinted Slimeball, then using the imprint on the mob detector. A filtered mob detector can be reset to detect all entities by using a regular slimeball on it, or breaking the block.

The blocks check for entities at a default rate of once every 10 ticks; this can be changed in the server config.

See images for recipes

ItemPickupNotifier is a lightweight client-side mod that displays clean, minimalistic pop-up notifications whenever the player receives new items. Instead of tracking individual inventory slots or relying on server packets, the mod continuously monitors the player’s entire inventory and calculates the exact difference between the previous and current state. This makes the detection extremely reliable and fully compatible with every server.

The system updates once per tick and counts the total amount of each item inside the player’s hotbar and main inventory. If the total amount of a specific item increases, a smooth notification appears in the bottom-right corner of the screen. Each notification includes the item icon, item name, and the amount gained, fading out naturally after a short duration.

After closing the door, and securing dinner, with great effort, you shuffled through the contents of your bag to confirm the presence of your belongings after your tumultuous journey. An odd, smooth shape introduces itself to your fingertips. What you withdraw has no visible seams nor identifying marks--save, that is, those on the paper disks that fell out as you examined the foreign object.

On each notched disk, two lines of text: A unique title, enclosed in quotes, and dis-unique to the lot, the word "THETISCOPE" in block print.

You found that each disk, when loaded into the device, "shifted" your perspective somewhat, in a way you found difficult to describe. Worse, words failed others who witnessed its use--and these lacking external descriptions were as dissimilar to your internal experience as they were incomprehensible.

A disquiet now rises when you think of the Thetiscope. Yet

one-chunk-blocks:
One Chunk Blocks turns world generation into a chunk-by-chunk block mosaic.

 After terrain and features are generated, each chunk is assigned one deterministic block from a large palette. Most
 solid blocks inside that chunk are then replaced with that chosen block, so one chunk may become stone, another may
 become quartz, another may become obsidian, copper, terracotta, wood, planks, or many other full blocks.

 Gameplay

 This mod creates a chaotic and unusual survival world where every new chunk can look completely different from the
 previous one. It is meant for challenge runs, strange exploration, and worlds that feel unpredictable without fully
 breaking progression.

 Notes

 This mod affects newly generated chunks. Existing terrain that was already generated before installing the mod will
 not be changed.

One Chunk Blocks将世界的生成变成了一个方块一个方块的方块马赛克。 在地形和要素生成后，每个方块都被分配一个来自大调色板的确定性方块。大多数 然后，该方块中的实心方块被替换为所选的方块，因此一个方块可以变成石头，另一个方块可以 变成石英，另一个可能变成黑曜石，铜，赤陶，木材，木板，或许多其他完整的方块。 玩法 这个模组创造了一个混乱和不寻常的生存世界，每个新的方块可以看起来完全不同的 它是为挑战性的跑步，奇怪的探索，和感觉不可预测的世界，而不是完全 中断进程。 注意到 这个模组会影响新生成的区方块。在安装模组之前已经生成的现有地形会 不能更改。

---

This mod introduces a new leveling system that dynamically scales mobs depending on the performance of the player. Through the leveling system, mobs can spawn with more health, better armor, and effects . Predominantly, the leveling system is based off of the time-to-kill for mobs, and adjusts as the player survives. This helps to aid in the feeling of possible end-game weapons or items killing mobs too quickly.

What sets this mod apart is the adaptation to player performance, most notably if performance decreases . Most mods only involve upward progression and does not take into account of player dying, losing equipment, etc. This mod addresses this issue in a manner where if performance deviates in both negative manners, the system will scale mobs appropriately so that mobs are not completely overpowered as the player regains items.

Adds a grappling hook, but...

The hook added in this mod follows the physics of an idealised (linear elastic) spring, i.e. Hooke's law - instead of pulling you all the way to the hook, it attempts to pull you to (by default) 4 blocks away. For extra fun, the hook itself also follows these physics when it's not embedded in a block.

The mod also adds three enchantments;
- Stiffness (I-III) - increases the acceleration that the hook's spring applies
- Resting Range (I-III) - allows you to change the distance that the hook attempts to pull/push you to
 - (3-5 blocks for I, 2-6 for II, 1-7 for III)
- Boosting - launches you backwards slightly whenever you fire the hook

You can either sneak+scroll or fire+scroll to change the hook's resting distance in increments of 0.5 blocks, or 0.1 if both at once.

Also has optional Area Lib compatibility to disallow hook usage in areas with the grappli

Tetrawear
 

Tetrawear is an armor addon for tetra. Apart from modular armor pieces, tetrawear also introduces energy and temperature systems to the game to make for a wider array of choices when it comes to crafting armor.

Tetrawear starts off the same way as tetra: place a piece of vanilla armor in the workbench, then you can change or add new modules and make improvements.

 Energy

PerceptiFrame is a standalone client-side Fabric optimization mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 with a self-profiling render-cost scheduler.

It measures the real CPU time of individual entity feature passes, learns a moving cost model for every entity type, and compares that cost with the entity's projected screen size. Maximum FPS mode continuously avoids the least visible work with the highest measured cost.

 Features

- Self-learning performance model
- Separate measured render cost for every entity type
- Maximum FPS mode
- Pixel-based detail prioritization
- Adaptive entity shadow optimization
- Protection for nearby and outlined entities
- Optional protection for player equipment and cosmetic layers
- Complete in-game settings screen
- F10 settings shortcut
- Optional Mod Menu integration
- Client-side only
- No telemetry or external connections
- No server installation re

imitari:
Imitari is a powerful Minecraft mod that introduces "CopyBlocks" - intelligent building blocks that can mimic and replicate the appearance, properties, and behavior of any other block in the game. This mod transforms how players approach construction and creative building.

Core Features

 Dynamic Block Mimicry: 

- CopyBlocks automatically adopt the visual appearance of any block placed into them, as long as it is a 1x1x1 block
- Physics properties like hardness and explosion resistance are dynamically inherited and scaled appropriately
- Sound effects match the copied block perfectly
- Block tags are inherited (with configurable blacklists for game balance)

 Intuitive Interaction: 

- Right-click any CopyBlock with a block item to "program" it to mimic that block
- Shift + empty hand removes the copied block
- Creative mode: Middle-click (with shift) to get a copy of the stored block

This mod aims to fix a bug when typing in the Creative Inventory Tab search bar when Create is installed. Create checks for key presses almost always, but if a keybind is not assigned or invalid, the entire game crashes when pressing a key in this area.

This mod uses a mixin to override this potential problem by treating the bad keybind as a key not being pressed, thus bypassing the issue by returning a valid result of 'false'.

 Note: The mod has been tested with the following mod versions:

- Create 6.0.10 (invalid/unassigned keybinds do not crash anymore, assigned keys still work)
- Ponder (ponder keybind still works)

Other mods have not been tested extensively, but casual-play should result in most Create addons working as intended.

looping-world:
Looping World mod takes the hard edges off the world border.
Step too far, and you’ll be teleported to the opposite side of the map, creating a seamless, looping world.

It teleports the player by calculating their position relative to the world border and mirroring it to the opposite side:
 

It always finds a safe spot, prevents fall damage, and avoids dangerous blocks. Works completely server-side and fits any existing world — just enable the world border.

Perfect for small maps, survival challenges, adventure maps, or experimenting with new world designs.

 Note: In the Nether, players are teleported to the roof, so make sure you have a way to get back down.

fluid-interaction-tweaker:
If you like this project, don't forget to give it a star⭐ - here!

 Overview

 This is a (1.12.2 Minecraft Forge) CraftTweaker/GroovyScript addon that enables you to add more fluid interactions using the zenscript / groovyscript .
 This mod doesn't extend anything on the vanilla water and lava interaction system. Instead, the mod creates a new general system for fluid interactions.
 It can also act as a library mod for fluid interactions.

 Features

 Fluid Interaction

 Fluid turns into another block when it comes into contact with another fluid.
 Fluid turns into another block when it comes into contact with a block.
 A block turns into another block when it comes into contact with fluid.
 Any of the above reactions can trigger a series of events. The available events are as follows:
 Placing a block
 Explosion
 Spawning an entity
 Spawning an item

This Mod adds a group of items called Essence, when you start a game you get a Blank Essence, and when right clicked it will transform into one of the seven possible Essences:

- Strength Essence
- Boost Essence
- Wealth Essence
- Ocean Essence
- Heart Essence
- Air Essence
- Cave Essence
 

Each of these gives permanent effects to the player, helping with progression. To change your Essence you must craft a Essence Switcher, using 3 of each Shard scattered across the dimensions. This will allow you to reset your Essence and choose a new one.

 Original Desc

 Vulkanite

Vulkanite is a modpack based on the excellent mod Vulkan Renderer.

The goal is to give the most performance and to have the best experience in Minecraft while staying close to Vanilla.
 How does the modpack work?

Using the Vulkan Renderer mod changes the rendering from OpenGL 3.3+ to Vulkan 1.3. This allows the average Minecraft player to play with a very high framerate while taking advantage of their own hardware.

This modpack is approved by xCollateral, the developer of the mod at its core : Vulkan Renderer.

This modpack should run on Windows without any problems and run on Linux pretty much equally good. This modpack doesn't work on Mac OS X.

holopack:
You want to build crazy Holograms in your Minecraft world?
 
Use this easy to use Data Pack to convert your builds into small useful Holograms!

 How to get started
 
Installing the Data Pack:
Download the newest version of the Data Pack here and put it into the "datapacks" folder of your world or server.
Now use the command /reload to load the Data Pack.

Getting the Holo Editor Item (This is all you need to create Holograms and edit them)
If you use the command /reload a text will appear in the chat. If you click this text you will get the Holo Editor Item.
Alternative you can use the command /tag @s add holo item to get the item.

Placing the Hologram Platform (This is the place where you can build your Holograms)
If you press [Q] with the Holo Editor Item in your hand, while no other Hologram Platform exist in your world, a big Selection-Box will appear.
Use your mouse to position it

minecraft-but-random-hearts:
The Random Hearts datapack adds a chaotic twist to Minecraft survival. Every 30 seconds, your maximum health changes to a random value! One moment you might have only 2 hearts, and the next you could have 20. This keeps the game unpredictable and forces you to constantly adapt.

 Features 
- ⏱️ Automatic heart changes: Every 30 seconds your maximum hearts are randomized.
- 🎲 Unpredictable gameplay: Never know how much health you’ll have next.
- ⚔️ Survival challenge: Makes fights, exploration, and survival more intense.
- 🌍 Multiplayer ready: Fun chaos when playing with friends on a server.

 Compatibility 
- ✅ Minecraft 1.21.2 and above
- 🛠️ Works in both singleplayer and multiplayer
- 📂 Easy installation with no mods required

 Installation 
1. Download the .zip file.
1. Put it inside your world’s datapacks folder.
1. Run /reload in-game.

Watch your hearts change every 30 seconds!

随机红心数据包为《我的世界》的生存增加了一个混乱的转折。每30秒，你的最大生命值就会变成一个随机值！前一刻你可能只有2颗红心，下一刻你可能有20颗。这让游戏变得不可预测，迫使你不断地适应。 特征 - 自动️心脏变化：每30秒，您的最大心脏数被随机化。 - 🎲不可预测的游戏玩法：永远不知道你接下来会有多少生命值。 - 生存️挑战：使战斗，探索和生存更激烈。 - 🌍多人游戏就绪：与朋友在服务器上玩游戏时，会出现有趣的混乱。 兼容性 - Minecraft 1.21.2及以上版本 - 🛠️适用于单人和多人游戏 - 📂安装方便，无需改装 安装 1.下载.zip文件。 1.把它放在你的世界的数据包文件夹里。 1.在游戏中执行/重新载入。 看你的心每30秒就变一次！

A resource pack for Minecraft Transit Railway. 

 Overview
The British Rail Class 153 Super Sprinter is a class of Diesel Multiple Units (DMU) converted from 35 British Rail Class 155 s originally produced by Leyland Bus.
During the late 80s, shortly after British Rail (Regional Railways sector) took delivery of the 35 Class 155 units, a need for replacing aging railcars such as Class 121 Bubble Car s was required, leading to RR deciding to convert all Class 155s they had into railcars to accomplish this. The 7 units delivered for West Yorkshire Passenger Transport Executive (155341-155347) were not included in this plan. 

The work took place from 1991 to 1992 by Hunslet-Barclay (Now Brodie Engineering) in their Kilmarnock plant. The conversion involves reclassifying these Class 155s as Class 153s and removing the luggage rack on the end of the vehicle (originally without a cab) and ret

一个为Minecraft运输铁路的资源包。 概述 英国铁路153型超级短跑车是由莱兰巴士公司最初生产的35辆英国铁路155型柴油动车组改装而成的一种柴油动车组。 在80年代后期，英国铁路公司（地区铁路部门）接收了35辆155型车，需要更换老化的轨道车，如121型泡泡车，导致RR决定将所有的155级转换为轨道车，以实现这一目标。为西约克郡客运执行公司交付的7台（155341-155347）未纳入本计划。 这项工作是从1991年到1992年由Hunslet-Barclay（现在的Brodie Engineering）在他们的基尔马诺克工厂进行的。转换包括将这些155级重新分类为153级，并拆除载具末端的行李架（最初没有驾驶室），并重新设计。

The Fukuoka City Subway 1000 and 2000 series trains are narrow gauge DC electric multiple units that operate on the Kuko (Airport) and Hakozaki Lines of the Fukuoka City Subway network and on the JR Kyushu Chikuhi Line to Chikuzen-Maebaru. This pack adds these trains to Minecraft Transit Railway as retextures of the mod's default Eidan (Tokyo Metro) 9000 series train.

Minecraft Transit Railway is required for this pack.

Contents:

- Fukuoka Subway 1000 Series (regular and mini variants)
- Fukuoka Subway 2000 Series (regular and mini variants)

Small shield — The shield now takes up less space on the screen, giving you more freedom of view while maintaining its functionality in combat.

 What is it?
Emissive Library is a core shader resource pack that adds support for emissive textures in vanilla Minecraft.
Pixels marked within the textures will glow, maintaining their original color and intensity even in darkness, and remaining unaffected by world lighting or shadows.

It acts as a foundation: on its own, it makes no visual changes, but it enables other resource packs to implement emissive effects without the need for mods or external shader packs.

 Why use it?
- No mods required: Works entirely through resource packs in vanilla Minecraft.
- Simple to use: Just adjust the alpha value of the pixels—no extra configuration files needed.
- A shared foundation: Multiple resource packs can rely on this single library, rather than each one including its own core shaders.

hyperopia:
A perceptual experiment in inverted spatial focus. 

 

Hyperopia is an experimental Minecraft shader that explores depth perception by reversing the relationship between distance and focus. Instead of enhancing realism, the shader intentionally disrupts familiar visual cues by making distant geometry appear visually prioritized while nearby objects gradually lose sharpness.

 

The effect is achieved through a depth-dependent post-processing pass that inverts the scene's depth response. Objects that would normally attract attention due to proximity become increasingly blurred, while distant structures remain clear and visually stable. A slowly oscillating depth threshold continuously shifts the focus boundary, creating subtle changes in spatial interpretation over time.

 

Rather than functioning as a traditional aesthetic shader, Hyperopia can be viewed as a small visual perception st

The functionality of the plugin is enabled by default but may be disabled either in the config file or with the command.

 yml

 Command
